2608.10837.title: TACTICL: Task-Aware Compression of Tabular ICL Models
2608.10837.paper_summary: The strong performance of foundation models for tabular tasks comes at substantial inference costs. Distilling models into task-specific architectures reduces model size and computational demands but also sacrifices in-context adaptability. Here we introduce TACTICL, an automated task-aware compression framework for tabular in-context learning models that jointly prunes transformer layers and replaces them with lightweight adapters trained on downstream tasks, thus blending in-context with in-weight learning. We study TACTICL on 47 benchmark datasets and show that we can substitute up to 85% of layers without substantial performance drop on a given downstream task. We further show that TACTICL maintains robustness to data shifts, leaving its in-context ability intact. Overall, TACTICL provides a robust framework for exploiting the depth-wise redundancy of tabular foundation models by combining task-specific adaptation and structured compression. We provide the code at: https://github.com/Hebog/tfm_compression
2608.10837.paper_summary_zh: 基於表格任務的基礎模型的強大表現伴隨著相當可觀的推理成本。將模型提煉成特定任務的架構可以減少模型大小和計算需求，但也犧牲了上下文適應性。在這裡，我們介紹了TACTICL，一個自動化的任務感知壓縮框架，專為表格上下文學習模型設計，該框架共同修剪Transformer層並用在下游任務上訓練的輕量級適配器替換它們，從而將上下文學習與權重學習相結合。我們在47個基準數據集上研究TACTICL，並顯示我們可以在不顯著降低給定下游任務性能的情況下替換多達85%的層。我們進一步顯示TACTICL對數據變化保持穩健，使其上下文能力保持完整。總體而言，TACTICL提供了一個穩健的框架，通過結合特定任務的適應性和結構化壓縮，利用表格基礎模型的深度冗餘。我們提供代碼在：https://github.com/Hebog/tfm_compression
